system.description:
Also at 5th level, you’ve learned a secret technique capable to halting even the most physically dominant opponent in their tracks. The technique you learn is one that is informed by your form of combat. Select one of three different Martial Techniques that you learn that enable your style of fighting. This cannot be changed later. These techniques can all be triggered when you score an unarmed or Taijutsu attack that deals unarmed damage and spending 2 Martial Dice.

If triggered as a result of a Taijutsu, if the Taijutsu you cast would already force a saving throw, you replace it with this Martial Techniques saving throw, applying both the Martial technique and the jutsu’s effects on a failed save. You may select a second Martial Technique from this list when you reach 11th level. If you would use any combination of two of these Martial Techniques, as part of a Taijutsu you cast, you must pick which one replaces the Taijutsu’s saving throw, and the other forces a second save to apply its own effects.
